author: National Geographic
description:
When the Pentagon was attacked on September 11, Commander Craig Powell was still learning his way around—putting him directly below the second-story window that Lt. Col. Marilyn Wills had led five survivors to while looking for an escape. Now, 25 years later, they have the chance to reunite. 

#911Reunited is now streaming on Disney+ and Hulu.

author: National Geographic
description:
Who were the Minoans, and did the Minotaur really exist?  In this full episode of Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece from National Geographic, archaeologists unearth the secrets of the mysterious Minoans — the ancient civilization that gave rise to the legends of King Minos, the terrifying Minotaur, and the Labyrinth. In this documentary series, archaeologists hunt for lost secrets of ancient history, from the Trojan War mentioned in The Odyssey, to powerful rulers and mysterious legends. Excavations uncover new evidence about the wonders of ancient Greece, a civilization that changed the world.
